name: Prior-phase features remain functional in a non-default locale
description: Adding i18n must not regress earlier features. On a Spanish match page the bracket navigation, predictions, and odds tab must still render their real data (translated labels, but populated content), with no layout break from longer translated strings. A localization layer that empties or breaks these tabs fails this test.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /api/matches and capture the first match id
Open the predictions/odds content tab on the Spanish match page

Verify the prior-phase content (prediction verdict and/or per-book odds with concrete values) still renders populated on the Spanish page, with labels translated and no obvious layout break (no overflowing/clipped text, no empty panel). If a prior feature renders empty or broken under /es, the test fails.
